Subject: Pilot Charter + Evaluation Plan — TerraFin Analytics

Hi Courtney / Jordan —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our conversation and a proposed pilot (POC) charter so we can move to scheduling the technical kickoff. Please review and flag anything missing or incorrect.

High-level pain & goals you shared
- Inconsistent extraction quality from customer support transcripts (entity/intent F1 varies between 0.62-0.72 across languages).
- Latency spikes during peak ingestion windows causing downstream queueing for real-time routing.
- Need a lightweight reranking layer for high-precision suggestions to reduce false positives in automated triage.

Success criteria for the 30-day pilot
- Accuracy: improvement to end-to-end F1 >= 0.85 on the agreed prompt/eval set (English + Spanish).
- Latency: p95 inference < 200ms for 512-token requests under the pilot batch profile.
- Cost target: average token cost <= $0.003/token during pilot (with batching/kv-cache).
- Operational: telemetry and traceable request ids available in Console for the pilot scope.

Scope and deliverables
- Deliver a prompt/eval suite (Redwood template) and run baseline vs optimized model/quantization profile.
- Integration: Redwood-hosted inference endpoint + short-lived sandbox API keys for TerraFin ingestion.
- Monitoring: Dashboard access (latency, token usage, per-route error rates).

Owners (initial)
- Redwood: Priya (SE, engagement lead), Karthik (AM, contract), runtime engineer — will assign after kickoff.
- TerraFin: Courtney (product lead), Jordan (eng. lead) — please confirm engineering owner if different.

Data & access needs (to start the pilot)
- A redacted sample of support transcripts (CSV or S3) with at least 10k rows — sample schema attached (terrafin-data-sample-schema.csv).
- Network reachability for sandbox endpoints (we can provide IPs) or short-lived API key if you prefer hosted route.
- Confirm any encryption/KMS requirements for logs and cached artifacts.

Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): Agree scope, sign SOW (DocuSign link below), provide sample data and legal contact.
- Week 1: Sandbox access, baseline run, prompt set creation.
- Week 2: Iteration on prompts, quantization trials, and initial monitoring.
- Week 3-4: Finalize evals, compare against success criteria, present findings.

Attachments: redwood-poc-scope.pdf (scope + eval template), terrafin-data-sample-schema.csv
Related links: HubSpot deal / drive doc / DocuSign (see footer).

Asks / immediate next steps
1) Courtney — confirm engineering owner and whether data must remain in your VPC for the pilot.
2) Jordan — share sample data by EOD Monday (we only need a 1–2k-row sample to run initial baselines).
3) TerraFin legal contact (for DPA/terms) — who should we loop in?

If everything looks good, we can lock a kickoff slot next week (I suggested Mon/Tue in my calendar).

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

—
Priya Natarajan
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the clear summary — this matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side:

Data & security
- We can provide a redacted sample (CSV) by Monday. The full dataset has PII so production runs will require a DPA and specific encryption controls.
- Our security team requires SOC 2 evidence and confirmation that cached KV data is encrypted at rest; I can loop Maria Gomez (maria.gomez@terrafingov.com) from security/legal.

Scope adjustments
- We want to scope the pilot to two common intents (billing dispute, routing to specialist) and English + Spanish only — that should be sufficient for measuring lift.

Legal / procurement
- Legal will need a short SOW and our standard terms redlined. Please send SOW + draft DPA — I’ll route to Maria.

We are generally comfortable with a hosted sandbox for the pilot as long as logs are encrypted and retention is limited to 30 days.

Courtney
Product Lead, TerraFin Analytics
